attempts.summary: Deployed a Python http.server app on node2:8080, terminated a WireGuard tunnel on node1 (wg0, 10.200.0.1/24, UDP 51820) with node3 as the sole peer (10.200.0.2/32), and used VyOS NAT+forward-filter on node1 to masquerade WireGuard-tunneled traffic destined for node2 as node1's LAN IP. node2's firewalld restricts TCP/8080 to source 10.100.47.10/32 (node1 only), so node3 can reach the app only via the tunnel through node1, never directly. All three nodes were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory protocol; each showed a changed OS boot_id and fully recovered app/tunnel/firewall state, with WireGuard handshakes re-establishing automatically afterward.
